# Nibaha Haq | Academic Support Services

> Academic support for Virtual University (VU) Pakistan students: VULMS handling (quizzes, assignments, GDBs, lecture attendance), code-wise Midterm and Finalterm exam files for 606+ course codes, and Final Year Project (FYP) guidance. Based in Pakistan, run by Nibaha Haq, 3+ years experience, 200+ student accounts handled.

## Services
- [VULMS Handling](https://lmshandling.com/services/lms-services): quiz, assignment, GDB, and lecture attendance management
- [Midterm Files](https://lmshandling.com/services/midterm-files): code-wise objective and subjective midterm exam preparation files
- [Finalterm Files](https://lmshandling.com/services/finalterm-files): code-wise objective and subjective finalterm exam preparation files
- [Final Year Project Support](https://lmshandling.com/services/final-year-project): proposal, OAR/internship report, PPT, and viva guidance

## Guides
- [VU Summer Semester Registration Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-summer-semester-registration-guide): How VU Summer Semester registration works on VULMS - step-by-step process, offered subjects, approximate fee, and whether you should take it based on your CGPA.
- [VU Midterm and Finalterm Exam Preparation Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-midterm-finalterm-exam-preparation-guide): A practical guide to VU midterm and finalterm exam preparation - how VU exams work, a smart study strategy, and how code-wise exam files help raise your CGPA.
- [VU Final Year Project (FYP) Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-final-year-project-fyp-guide): A complete VU FYP roadmap - choosing an organization, writing an OAR/Internship Report that doesn't get rejected, PPT prep, and viva - with real case studies.
- [Virtual University Admission Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/virtual-university-admission-guide): Virtual University (VU) admission guide - eligibility, admission fee, online form, required documents, and final submission for BS, ADP, MCS, MBA and more.
- [VU Finalterm Notes PDF 2026](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-finalterm-notes-pdf-2026): Download VU finalterm notes PDF 2026 for all subjects - solved Objective MCQs and Subjective short and long questions, code-wise, matched to VU's own lectures.
- [CS101 MCQs Objective Notes](https://lmshandling.com/blog/cs101-mcqs-objective-notes): CS101 (Introduction to Computing) Objective MCQs for VU midterm and finalterm - code-wise notes matched to VU's own lectures, plus a real 80% result.
- [VU GDB (Graded Discussion Board) Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-gdb-graded-discussion-board-guide): How VU GDB (Graded Discussion Board) works on VULMS, the word limit, deadline, marking criteria, plagiarism rules, and how to write a high-scoring GDB post.
- [VU Assignment Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-assignment-guide): How VU assignments work on VULMS: formatting rules, submission steps, the similarity/plagiarism check, deadlines, and how to write a high-scoring assignment.
- [VU Quiz Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-quiz-guide): How VU quizzes work on VULMS: where to find them, the activation window, MCQ format, how to prepare efficiently, and mistakes that cost marks.
- [VU Attendance Guide](https://lmshandling.com/blog/vu-attendance-guide): How VU lecture attendance works on VULMS: what counts as attendance, why staying current matters, where to check it, and common mistakes to avoid.
- [CS201 Midterm and Finalterm Notes](https://lmshandling.com/blog/cs201-midterm-finalterm-notes): CS201 (Introduction to Programming) midterm and finalterm notes: code-wise Objective and Subjective files matched to VU's own lecture content.
